description: Put a saved chart onto a dashboard at a position (the end by default) with a width; charts below move down. Returns the new layout. Layout: the dashboard is a grid of 3 columns, charts go in the order of their position and wrap into rows. width_size 1 = a third, 2 = two thirds, 3 = a full row. Keep the sum of widths in every row equal to 3 (3, 2+1, 1+2, 1+1+1), otherwise a row has an empty hole. Good widths: a line or bars over time 2 or 3, a funnel 2 or 3 (up to 4 steps fit without scrolling at width 1), TOTAL bars and retention 1 or 2.

chart_id.description: Chart ID from analytics_chart_create or analytics_dashboard_get

position.description: Place counting from 0. At the end when not set

width_size.description: 1 = a third of the row, 2 = two thirds, 3 = full row. Default 1

name: analytics_dashboard_add_chart
